facts.fact: Government set a target to train 400,000 Ghanaians in 2026 under the One Million Coders Programme, after a 2025 pilot that trained 859, with 20,000 laptops procured and training planned in 100 constituencies by end of the first quarter of 2026.

systems.owner: Ministry of Communications, Digital Technology and Innovations

note: The 859 pilot trainees' locations are not stated.
